title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 08/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS (S1) and Maxell MX-Metal (S2). Set up FOB, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with good sound captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a tribal Rhythm Devils section and a Phil‑heavy Not Fade Away.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for being clear enough to earn a solid four‑star rating, delivering an enjoyable listening experience despite the usual crowd ambience. Fans love the “tribal” Rhythm Devils groove and note that Not Fade Away shines with a heavy Phil bass presence, while Sugaree feels bouncy and JGB‑style.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 stars) was provided; it is positive about both performance and recording, so the rating reflects a solid but not exceptional show with good audience sound.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review mentions the tape "sounds good enough" and appreciates finally having an audience version; no major flaws noted, implying decent clarity for a crowd recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows through a tribal Rhythm Devils segment and maintains strong momentum, especially on the Phil‑heavy Not Fade Away.

band_member_comments.Phil: Heavy bass presence highlighted, particularly on Not Fade Away.
band_member_comments.Drums: Rhythm Devils provide a tribal beat that drives the performance.
